criteria.evidence: The adapter validates a real root, safe remote/branches and full local HEAD, requires one parseable push URL and active host authentication, filters exact repository owner/head/base locally, rejects full-page and multiple PR results, bounds command output, and returns closed stage/state results with fixed diagnostics. runCommand uses spawnSync with shell:false and prompt suppression; tests use only an injected fake runner and distinguish unavailable, Git, remote, auth, head and lookup failures.

Publish uses the exact non-force refspec EXPECTED:refs/heads/STORY, never adds tracking/config/bypass flags, and re-reads the exact PR after create/edit/ready. However withBodyFile at remote.mjs:495 builds from os.tmpdir() without making the path absolute and relies on openSync mode0600 without fchmod. A relative TMPDIR remains relative in Node, and an isolated review probe with process.umask(0777) produced actual mode000. Existing tests only observe an ordinary absolute TMPDIR and ordinary umask, so they do not prove the required absolute exact-mode file on every outcome.

Inspect and merge require exact PR identity/head, classify exit0 check JSON buckets, treat nonzero structured JSON as CHECKS_UNKNOWN, and accept either exact no-check exit1 message only after a fresh OPEN/non-draft MERGEABLE+CLEAN view. Merge rechecks the exact clean head, invokes gh without admin/auto using --match-head-commit and an explicit method, treats an accepted but still-open PR as MERGE_PENDING, and reports MERGED only after a full mergeCommit OID equals the single remote integration ref. Tests cover failed/pending/unknown checks, exact no-check messages, blocked state, head race, refusal, queueing and remote-base mismatch. Coordinator npm test passed 142 tests and npm run validate passed at snapshot ec1d3e38373cffe052fcdeac99ff3f1d3d94c51fd45fe3745fa6b5f60fcff263.
